notes.title: Sword of the Necromancer Prologue V2
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

Now that we have some time, we decided to update the Prologue to include major tweaks and features that were present only in the full game. 

[b]With this you can see better what the full game is like before getting it.[/b]

[h1]New features[/h1]

[h2]Forge[/h2]
When you smash pots and break boxes in the dungeon you might find materials. Use those materials in the Forge to [b]upgrade your weapons and relics[/b]!

[h2]Item Bag[/h2]
Ever came across a good item or new monster but your inventory was full and you didn't want to get rid of anything? Now [b]with the Item Bag you have 4 more slots[/b] you can use to store items that are not active! The items in the bag also won't be lost when you die. Ever.

[h2]Game Settings[/h2]
Is the game too hard for you? Maybe too easy? Do you like the game but think that it would be better if dying didn't mean losing half your level and your items? [b]You can customize your game to get the better experience for yourself![/b] After clearing the tutorial you will unlock a new option in Settings, the Game Settings, which let you change all of this.

[h2]Japanese Dub[/h2]
Watch the scenes with Japanese voice over!

[h2]Other[/h2]
Several fixes and gameplay tweaks, more room layouts, new items like the Coin of Nodam (which revives you automatically if you have it equipped and die), etc.

We hope you enjoy this update. If you liked the Prologue, leave a good review and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243890/Sword_of_the_Necromancer/]get the full game[/url] ([i]and leave a good review there too after playing a good chunk of the game![/i])

Kind regards!
